name: Finish Brothers
original_name: フィニッシュブラザーズ
source:
A girl is brought to the local bathhouse by her father. Nothing out of the ordinary here.
Except for all the lecherous old men that are gawking at her body.

When her father heads off to the sauna, they waste no time to making an approach...
